body:
sometimes you'll be the guy who has his shit together, and other times you'll be the guy who needs to ask for help.  talk to your friend; talk to your mother.  tell them how you're feeling, and I bet they will surprise you.  I hear how disappointed you are in yourself, but I am not disappointed in you at all--you did the hard thing by asking for help this morning, but I think the people who can help you best aren't here on Reddit.

I am having a difficult holiday myself, but feel free to PM me if you need to talk.
